    export interface RunAdaptersOptions<T> {
        adapters: Array<SiteAdapter<T>>;
        optionsFor?(adapter: SiteAdapter<T>): AdapterRunOptions;
        client?: ScrapeClientOptions | ScrapeClient;
        browser?: BrowserSessionOptions | BrowserSession | false;
        verbose?: boolean;
    }
  ScrapeClient (packages/scrape/src/fetch/http.ts)
    export class ScrapeClient {
        readonly userAgent: string;
        readonly rateLimiter: RateLimiter;
        readonly robots: RobotsCache;
        constructor(options?: ScrapeClientOptions);
        get(url: string, opts?: FetchOptions): Promise<Response>;
        getJson<T = unknown>(url: string, opts?: FetchOptions): Promise<T>;
        getPage(url: string, opts?: FetchOptions): Promise<FetchedPage>;
        getText(url: string, opts?: FetchOptions): Promise<string>;
    }
